title: With another expansion of its international series, the NFL is plowing the road for an 18-game schedule

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With another expansion of its international series, the NFL is plowing the road for an 18-game schedule
sources.description: Previously, franchises were granted the right to protect two scheduled opponents from being chosen for international games. The NFL eliminated that protection as part of the new ceiling of 10 overseas games.
